blocks.orig: Sitting on the upper slopes of Mount Kilimanjaro, the Kilimanjaro Coffee Lodge offers a restful and eco-friendly stay in the heart of an organic coffee estate. Overlooking the coffee fields and decorated along the theme of coffee, each of the six double bedrooms is furnished with beautifully crafted, locally made furniture and two (!) spacious bathrooms. Enjoy the beautiful views over Mount Kilimanjaro from the main house and restaurant, indulge in a treatment at the spa, or a plunge in the swimming pool blended in with the surrounding rainforest… this is the ideal place to relax before or after your Kili-hike.
blocks.html: High on the slopes of Mount Kilimanjaro, the Kilimanjaro Coffee Lodge gives you a peaceful, eco-friendly stay in the middle of an organic coffee estate. The six double bedrooms look out over the coffee fields, follow a coffee theme in their decoration, and each has beautifully crafted furniture made locally plus two (!) spacious bathrooms. Take in the lovely views of Mount Kilimanjaro from the main house and restaurant, treat yourself at the spa, or take a dip in the swimming pool that blends into the rainforest around it… it is the perfect spot to unwind before or after your Kili-hike.
